name: District Plan - Sugarcane Development Scheme
benefit: 1. **Scheme for Improved Sugarcane Seed Production:** A subsidy of ₹1,000/- per hectare (₹2,000/- per hectare for SC/ST farmers) is provided for established/base nurseries, and ₹500/- per hectare (₹1,000/- per hectare for SC/ST farmers) is provided for primary nurseries.   1. **Seed/Soil Treatment:** A 50% subsidy is provided in all sugar mill areas for chemicals used in seed and soil treatment. O
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer cultivating sugarcane. 1. The applicant must be a permanent member of a cooperative sugarcane development society. 1. The applicant must practice advanced sugarcane farming. 1. The applicant’s name must be registered in the land records of the state.
